reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in his direct message to say so.

- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** the $2,101 per-seat rate Marcus gave, and a note that Anselm approved sharing it with Hollis.

It's only a draft, so nothing has been sent; someone still needs to send it.

Anselm's message counts as the approval: he's the CFO, so he can clear sharing a finance figure with Hollis. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve the mail.
